titleFormatted.en: Handle keypad entry with code [[pin]], key [[key]] from keypad [[keypad]]

hint.en: Connect this to your keypad's code-entered trigger and pass its code and key tags. Keys such as DISARM_ALL, ARM_HOME, ARM_AWAY, ENTER and CANCEL, or Disarm, Home and Away, are understood. The code is checked against the users, including the panic digits.
